rules: NOT_RUN is never PASS; a required positive cannot be skipped as Unsupported.
Expected Unsupported in a negative fixture is PASS only if all zero-mutation and receipt assertions also hold.
Evidence head and subject revision must be separate when evidence-only commits differ.
Missing fields/artifacts cannot be replaced by a green summary label.
One trace may satisfy multiple obligations; do not demand redundant executions.
Axioms check exact public/canonical values, not merely internal self-reported success.
